items.text: Improved critter movement: better speed values, smoother animation blending, and fixed hovering above ground.
AI commands now work on multiple livestock animals; added selection/deselection console variables and offset positioning to prevent stacking.
Scientist2 corpses no longer sit on the ragdoll layer, preventing them from blocking player movement and projectiles.
Fixed missing navmesh in rooms behind doors (e.g., missile silo, ghostship) by preventing doors from being baked as islands and pruning disconnected regions.
Navmesh now builds correctly on dive sites.
Monument blockers rebalanced: lowered HP (1 C4 or 5 satchels), adjusted sizes for oil rigs, launch sites, silos, and added small oil rig blocker.
Heavy pot helmet crafting cost increased (1 → 2 sheet metal, 4 → 8 HQM).
Playerboats now persist `timeSinceLastUsed`, fixing the no‑decay bug on daily‑restart servers.
Maintainables fixes: corrected water pipe spawn angles, ensured gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts, and applied prefab fixes to gas stations.
Disallowed looting of clipping player bodies while mounted to submarines; players must exit the submarine to loot.
Fixed incorrect "Can't be deployed on boats" message when a structure is badly placed.
Workbench upgrade rug deployment issues resolved.
Store UI now dynamically loads item overlay sprites correctly, fixing missing icons.
Demo UI animation loader fixed by marking clips as legacy.
Shield functionality fixes merged into main branch, improving defensive behavior.
HAB armor now requires holding E for 3 seconds to equip, preventing accidental equips; added equip effect and placeholder sound, and switched door sounds to chainlink.
Shop UI tiles are now clickable and missing icons fixed; static asset props marked NonSerialized to clean up dependencies.
Medical honey bandage instant health reduced from 10 to 8, healing over time increased from 4 to 6, and cloth craft cost lowered from 8 to 4.
High-quality ore spawner added with doubled min/max respawn delay, affecting ore availability.
Collider read/write fixes applied to improve interaction accuracy.
Removed unnecessary client-side colliders for HAB armor, streamlining collision handling.
Added admin invisible cube and wall attack variants that can be damaged by melee or shooting, enabling new combat interactions.
Implemented client-side prediction for grenades and thrown weapons, improving accuracy of drops and throws.
Separated HQM ore into its own population, making it spawn much rarer and added rare HQM collectible spawns with placeholder resource values.
Ensured oil rig radiation resets correctly on server restart if the force reset fails, maintaining intended hazard behavior.
Replaced mesh collider on HAB armour frame with box colliders, fixing collision detection for armour interactions.
Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.
Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

- Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

items.text: Radwater now scales its damage with protection, dealing significantly more damage to fully equipped kits.
Flashlight weapon toggles on/off with right‑click, removing the previous F‑key activation.

Semi‑automatic pistol gains stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material craft cost increased; SMG spawn chance slightly up and Rifle spawn chance slightly down for better mid‑game weapon balance.
Bear rug provides 100 % comfort within 2 m and regular rug within 1 m, fixing the prior 25 % solo comfort issue.
Monument blockers at Launch Site, Military Tunnels and Missile Silo have adjusted protection values and health for improved balance.
Modular car wheels now use correct models and normals, and car handling has been refined – less body roll, fewer spin‑outs, higher‑speed drifting and smoother steering.
Added rabbit animal with animation, model, and prefab.
Russian roulette DLC textures and material updated, fixing naming issues.
Hackable crates now correctly flagged and visually indicated; puzzlereset alerts suppressed after forced restart.
Group tax displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel.
Event crates and server gibs now persist across server restarts; fire state saved; crate despawn time reduced to 30 minutes; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons.
Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships corrected, improving AI navigation on those vessels.
Fixed AI fleeing behavior when players jump, ensuring enemies stay engaged.
Optimized friend list refresh, eliminating lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets in large teams.
HAB armour colliders fixed for proper removal on client and server, adding a collision mesh for the frame.
WireTool now correctly overrides third‑person idle/relax running stance, fixing tool animation.
Fixed session modal overflow and description scroll, restoring ability to disconnect from long description sessions.
Store UI now avoids sprite invalidation on opening, making all shop tiles clickable and fixing missing icons.
Added support for dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites in store item overlays, improving item preview rendering.
Siren off state now visible, clarifying when sirens are inactive.
Cover images in store items now enabled after initialization, ensuring proper visuals.
Restored DLC prefab setup to prevent errors when clicking DLC tiles in the store.
Improved dynamic shop asset loading; empty tiles created on warmup then filled, stabilizing store UI.

2026-08-25.summary:
### Combat & Weapon Balance
- Radwater now scales its damage with protection, dealing significantly more damage to fully equipped kits.
- Flashlight weapon toggles on/off with right‑click, removing the previous F‑key activation.
- Semi‑automatic pistol gains stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material craft cost increased; SMG spawn chance slightly up and Rifle spawn chance slightly down for better mid‑game weapon balance.

### Comfort & Environment
- Bear rug provides 100 % comfort within 2 m and regular rug within 1 m, fixing the prior 25 % solo comfort issue.
- Monument blockers at Launch Site, Military Tunnels and Missile Silo have adjusted protection values and health for improved balance.

### Vehicles & Handling
- Modular car wheels now use correct models and normals, and car handling has been refined – less body roll, fewer spin‑outs, higher‑speed drifting and smoother steering.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Added rabbit animal with animation, model, and prefab.
- Russian roulette DLC textures and material updated, fixing naming issues.
- Hackable crates now correctly flagged and visually indicated; puzzlereset alerts suppressed after forced restart.
- Group tax displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel.
- Event crates and server gibs now persist across server restarts; fire state saved; crate despawn time reduced to 30 minutes; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons.

### AI & Navigation
- Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships corrected, improving AI navigation on those vessels.
- Fixed AI fleeing behavior when players jump, ensuring enemies stay engaged.

### Performance
- Optimized friend list refresh, eliminating lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets in large teams.

### Vehicles & Combat
- HAB armour colliders fixed for proper removal on client and server, adding a collision mesh for the frame.
- WireTool now correctly overrides third‑person idle/relax running stance, fixing tool animation.

### UI & UX
- Fixed session modal overflow and description scroll, restoring ability to disconnect from long description sessions.
- Store UI now avoids sprite invalidation on opening, making all shop tiles clickable and fixing missing icons.
- Added support for dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites in store item overlays, improving item preview rendering.
- Siren off state now visible, clarifying when sirens are inactive.
- Cover images in store items now enabled after initialization, ensuring proper visuals.
- Restored DLC prefab setup to prevent errors when clicking DLC tiles in the store.
- Improved dynamic shop asset loading; empty tiles created on warmup then filled, stabilizing store UI.

items.text: Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.
